jobs.prompt: Minimalist illustration on a pure black background, clean thin white line art with no shading, white lines only, no colour at all. People, animals and objects are drawn WHITE: white bodies, white clothes, white fills, never black-filled shapes or dark silhouettes. No text, letters or captions in the image. Vertical 9:16 composition. Setting: a classroom in thin white line art: a blackboard, wooden desks. Scene: the teacher, a man drawn all in WHITE with glasses, a WHITE t-shirt and WHITE trousers, stands at the front of the class. He has exactly TWO arms: his RIGHT arm is bent at the elbow, holding a glass of water at chest height, relaxed and easy; his LEFT arm hangs straight down at his left side. Nothing else hangs at his right side: the right arm is only the one holding the glass. Calm easy smile, both feet flat on the floor. Normal human anatomy: each person has exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Each leg runs from the hip to ONE foot, the feet point the same way as the knees, no third foot or extra leg, and the legs of different people never merge or overlap; people in the background stand clearly apart from each other.
